'''Golf''' was a sport that could be played on [[Bar Neth]], a once arid [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that had been [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] and turned into a successful holiday resort. On Bar Neth, golf was praticed on zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] courses.<ref name="ST">[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] {{C|Tokyo only}}</ref>
